issue: Unauthenticated access to protected routes renders a blank page instead of a sign-in prompt or redirect
actual: While logged out, navigating directly to /create-listing and to /cart both rendered a completely blank page (document.body.innerText === '', no header, no content, no error). No sign-in prompt, no redirect to /login, and no visible message was shown to the unauthenticated user.

evidence: Submitting the create-listing form missing category, condition, and photo (with title/description/price/location filled) was blocked with toast 'Please fill in all required fields'; no listing was created. Separately, submitting a fully empty form triggers native HTML5 required-field validation (title/description/price/location marked required, price min=0).

Price field is type=number with min=0; entering -5 and submitting kept the form on-page (rangeUnderflow=true, validationMessage 'Value must be greater than or equal to 0.', no listing created). Attempting to type non-numeric text ('abc') into the price field was rejected by the browser itself (Playwright: 'Cannot type text into input[type=number]'), preventing non-numeric price entry entirely.

Created listing 'Upcycled Oak Side Table' with 2 sample photos, description, price $42.50, category Furniture, condition Good, location Seattle WA, and upcycled=true. After submit, redirected to My Listings showing the item as Active; product detail page displays photos, title, description, price ($42.5), category (Furniture), condition (Good), location (Seattle, WA), upcycled badge, seller (Tim QA Tester), and listing date, all matching submitted data.

issue: No edit functionality exists for existing listings
actual: On the My Listings page, each owned listing only exposes 'View', 'Mark Sold', and 'Delete' actions (confirmed via both semantic hints and full accessibility snapshot). The product detail page for an owned listing shows only a 'Manage Your Listings' link back to that page. No edit/update control or route is exposed anywhere in the UI, so sellers cannot edit title, description, photos, price, category, condition, or location of an existing listing.

evidence: On My Listings, clicking 'Mark Sold' immediately changed status to 'Sold' (button relabeled 'Mark Available'); clicking again reverted to 'Active'. Clicking 'Delete' opened a confirmation dialog ('Delete listing? This action cannot be undone...'); confirming removed the listing immediately, leaving My Listings showing 'No listings yet'.

Created listing 'FT4 Test Sold Item', marked it Sold via My Listings. Searching Browse for its exact title returned '0 items available' / 'No items found', and the overall available count remained at the baseline 10, confirming sold listings are excluded from browse/search results. No link anywhere in the buyer-facing UI (browse grid, search results) leads to a sold item's detail page, so buyers have no in-app path to add it to cart or start a purchase request.

Logged in as emma@example.com. Viewing prod-1 (owned by Emma Green) shows 'Manage Your Listings' seller control. Viewing prod-2 (owned by Marcus Chen, a different seller) shows no seller-management controls at all — only buyer actions 'Add to Cart' and 'Message Seller' are present, confirming seller-management actions are scoped to the signed-in seller's own listings.

Signed in as Emma Green, added prod-2 (Vintage Denim Jacket, owned by Marcus Chen) to cart. Cart page shows the item once, with photo, title 'Vintage Denim Jacket - Size M', location 'San Francisco, CA', price $65, and correct cart total $65.00.

Clicking 'Add to Cart' immediately showed toast 'Added to cart!' and updated the header cart badge to '1' without any reload. Navigating to cart (SPA) showed the line item, count '1 item', and total '$65.00' all correctly populated.
As Emma Green, opened 'Message Seller' dialog on prod-2 (owned by Marcus Chen), typed a non-empty message, Send button became enabled, clicking it produced visible toast 'Message sent to seller!'.

issue: No seller-facing view exists for buyer purchase requests or messages
actual: As buyer Emma Green, sent a 'Message Seller' text and a cart 'Send Purchase Request' for prod-2 (owned by Marcus Chen); both showed buyer-side confirmation toasts. Logged in as Marcus Chen (the seller) and checked My Listings and the product detail page for prod-2 — no message, purchase-request list, notification badge, or any UI element anywhere in the app surfaces the buyer's message or the purchase request to the seller. There is no inbox/requests page in the navigation (only Browse, Categories, About, Sell, Cart, user menu).

evidence: Searching 'WOOD' (uppercase) matched 3 items by title ('Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf'), description ('wood frame' in Armchair), and near-match ('Wooden Train Set') case-insensitively. Searching 'portland' (lowercase) matched exactly the 3 listings located in 'Portland, OR'. Clearing the search field restored the full 10-item baseline result set.

Typing into the search box updated the result grid and 'X items available' count instantly (10→3 for 'WOOD', 3 for 'portland') with no separate search/submit action; clearing the field instantly restored the count to 10.

issue: Filter combination logic incomplete: Price Range and Max Distance sliders do not function as true min/max range filters
actual: Category+condition combos, upcycled toggle, and sort (price low-to-high) all combined correctly and updated result counts/order as expected. However the 'Price Range' control (labeled '$0 - $500') exposes only a single adjustable 'Minimum' thumb (confirmed via DOM inspection: 2 duplicate sliders both aria-label='Minimum', valuemax hardcoded at 500) — there is no way to set a maximum price below $500, so results cannot be filtered by both a minimum AND maximum price as the checklist requires. The 'Max Distance' slider was moved through many values (50→26→25→24→23→12→1-range attempts) via keyboard and drag while 5 upcycled listings (from cities San Francisco/Brooklyn/Portland, presumably far from the signed-in seller's location) remained visible unchanged at every distance value tested, indicating the distance filter does not actually narrow the result set. DOM inspection also found the distance control duplicated as 2 identical unlabeled sliders (valuemax=50), matching the same duplication bug seen on the price slider.

evidence: Every filter/sort change (category checkbox, condition checkbox, upcycled toggle, price/distance slider drag, sort dropdown selection, search text) updated the visible product grid and the 'X items available' count immediately with no submit action or reload. Clicking 'Clear all filters' instantly unchecked all categories/conditions, reset price to $0-$500 and distance to default, turned off the upcycled toggle, and restored the full unfiltered baseline of 10 items in a single click.

issue: Category selection from the Categories page does not filter browse results
actual: On /categories, 'Furniture' was shown with a count of '3 items'. Clicking that category card navigated to '/?category=furniture', but the Browse page rendered all 10 unfiltered listings ('10 items available') and the 'Furniture' checkbox in the sidebar filter panel remained unchecked (state=false) — the category query parameter was placed in the URL but never applied to the actual product filter, so the result count (10) does not match the category's advertised count (3) and non-Furniture items (e.g. Yoga Mat, Denim Jacket, Headphones, Book Set) are still shown.

evidence: Checked multiple product detail pages (prod-10 'Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf' active/upcycled, prod-6 'Complete Harry Potter Book Set' after marking it sold, and prod-1 from FT-1). Each consistently displayed: photo, title, price, description, category (breadcrumb + badge), condition badge, location with distance ('Portland, OR (9 mi)' / 'San Francisco, CA (12 mi)'), seller name/photo/location, and listing date ('Listed 2024-11-23' / 'Listed 2024-11-10'). The upcycled badge appears only on listings flagged upcycled (prod-10) and is correctly absent on non-upcycled listings (prod-6), matching underlying data. Availability is also correctly surfaced: after marking prod-6 as sold via My Listings, its detail page replaced the Add to Cart/Message Seller actions with the text 'This item is no longer available', confirming availability status is shown consistently with the listing's actual state."
